title: Avacado dip
preamble:
2 ripe avocados

½ red onion, finely chopped

1 tomato, deseeded and finely chopped

Juice of 1 lime

Few drops of Tabasco, to taste
ingredients: Few drops of Tabasco, to taste
Small handful fresh coriander, chopped, plus extra to garnish
method: Halve, stone and peel the avocados.
Finely chop the flesh then add to a bowl.
Stir through the onion, tomato, lime juice, Tabasco, coriander and some seasoning.
Spoon mixture on to each chip.
